description: This file defines an IngredientParser class used for parsing ingredient strings into structured data, including handling units, food items, fractions, and notes, with integration to Django ORM models and automation rules.

classes.name: IngredientParser
classes.description: A class for parsing ingredient strings into structured ingredient objects, handling units, food, notes, and automations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the IngredientParser with request context, cache mode, and automation rules.

methods.name: get_unit
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Unit object based on the unit name, respecting automations.

methods.name: get_food
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Food object based on the food name, respecting automations.

methods.name: parse_fraction
methods.description: Parses a string representing a fraction or unicode fraction into a float.

methods.name: parse_amount
methods.description: Parses an amount string into a float, extracting units and notes.

methods.name: parse_food_with_comma
methods.description: Parses tokens to extract food and note when food is followed by a comma.

methods.name: parse_food
methods.description: Parses tokens to extract food and note, handling brackets and parentheses.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main function to parse an ingredient string into amount, unit, food, and note.

methods.name: parse_as_ingredient
methods.description: Converts a string into an Ingredient object with linked food and unit objects.
